# Sahar Ali

> Dubai-based tech consultant. I help teams adapt to AI for productive work, and I also cover automation, product, delivery, and data.

## About

I am Sahar Ali. I speak both business and engineering. I help teams adapt to AI: Jira MCPs, coding agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, and Copilot, and the working habits that make them stick. I have done this in startups, in large corporations, and with small businesses going through AI transformations. The work is about productive use of AI.

I have shipped 30+ products, including scaling Nuur AI from zero to 300K users, and I still build every day.
